description: Polyfill implementation of MutationObserver and WeakMap for environments lacking native support, including internal classes and functions for mutation observation.

classes.name: WeakMap
classes.description: Polyfill class for WeakMap, providing set, get, delete, and has methods.

classes.name: JsMutationObserver
classes.description: Polyfill class for MutationObserver, providing observe, disconnect, and takeRecords methods.

classes.name: MutationRecord
classes.description: Represents a mutation record with details about DOM mutations.

methods.name: WeakMap.prototype.set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the WeakMap.

methods.name: WeakMap.prototype.get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key.

methods.name: WeakMap.prototype.delete
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value.

methods.name: WeakMap.prototype.has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the WeakMap.

methods.name: JsMutationObserver.prototype.observe
methods.description: Starts observing a target node for specified mutations.

methods.name: JsMutationObserver.prototype.takeRecords
methods.description: Returns a list of mutation records.
